description: This file defines an implementation of the ExecutorChannelInterceptor for Spring Messaging, specifically for handling Spring Batch messages. It manages ThreadLocal context initialization and cleanup around message handling to ensure proper context management during batch processing.

classes.name: InputChannelInterceptor
classes.description: A channel interceptor for Spring Batch messaging that manages ThreadLocal context during message handling.

methods.name: beforeHandle
methods.description: Intercepts messages before handling, initializes ThreadLocal context based on the message payload.

methods.name: afterMessageHandled
methods.description: Performs cleanup of ThreadLocal context after message has been processed.

methods.name: beforeHandleMessage
methods.description: Prepares the message by extracting the ContextualMessage payload and creating a new GenericMessage.

methods.name: beforeHandleMessage (overloaded)
methods.description: Initializes ThreadLocal context with data from the ContextualMessage and returns the associated StepExecutionRequest.
